sources.title: September 2025 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
sources.kind: UPRN-level OMR and plans release with correction
facts: The release was published on 8 January 2026 and corrected on 2 February 2026.
The correction replaced files after supplier-name errors were identified.
limits: Corrected supplier names do not validate current orderability.
The release remains a dated snapshot.

sources.title: Project Gigabit winter update 2022 to 2023
facts: The policy paper covers programme progress, procurement pipeline, vouchers and public-sector hubs.
It was published on 27 February 2023.
limits: The update is historical.
Programme pipeline entries are not current service records.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: Project Gigabit Evaluation Plan
facts: The plan covers evaluation of Gigabit Infrastructure Subsidy and the voucher scheme.
It describes the role of UPRN eligibility lists and provider project proposals.
limits: An evaluation plan is not delivery evidence.
Proposed methodology does not establish outcomes at a premises.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: User guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans
facts: The guide says releases are planned alongside OMR updates approximately every four months.
It explains that a missing UPRN is not in the assessed OMR premises list.
limits: The guide reflects the March 2025 publication design.
The dataset is not suitable as a complete delivery history.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: Project Gigabit Delivery plan - winter update 2023
facts: The landing page summarises procurement and coverage reporting in the winter update.
It references contract awards and procurement launches current at publication.
limits: A publication landing page is lineage evidence.
Historic award and launch information does not establish current deployment.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: UPRN level release user guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans
facts: The guide was published on 4 June 2026.
It documents the January 2026 UPRN-level OMR and plans release.
limits: Technical documentation does not itself provide live availability.
The underlying snapshot date and quality notes remain material.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: Premises in BDUK plans (March 2025, England and Wales)
facts: The release describes BDUK's view of current connectivity, future plans and interventions.
It includes regional downloadable datasets.
limits: The March 2025 view is historical.
The data is not comprehensive for historic subsidised delivery.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: Building Digital UK (BDUK) performance information
facts: The collection links quarterly and annual delivery statistics, contract reports and annual accounts.
It was updated on 11 June 2026.
limits: A collection index is lineage evidence.
Different reports use different measures and periods.

sources.title: Building Digital UK Annual Report and Accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.kind: annual corporate and performance report landing page
facts: The report covers BDUK activities for 2024 to 2025.
It was published on 23 October 2025.
limits: An annual report is organisation-level evidence.
It does not establish current premises availability.

sources.title: Project Gigabit: UK subsidy advice
facts: The collection covers classification, disagreement resolution, wholesale access, pricing and reporting guidance.
It places Project Gigabit within the UK Subsidy Control Regime.
limits: Guidance is not proof of a specific award or build.
Each document has its own scope and version.
